name: What types of soft close drawer slides are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of soft close drawer slides are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of soft close drawer slides, each with different mounting options. Undermount slides are hidden beneath the drawer, offering a clean aesthetic and full extension. Side-mount slides are visible on the sides of the drawer box and are often more economical. Rear-mount slides attach to the back of the cabinet frame. The choice depends on cabinet construction, desired aesthetics, and weight capacity needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available types include undermount (hidden), side-mount (visible), and rear-mount slides, varying by aesthetic and function.
